result.stdout:
Usage: snap <namespace|command> [options]

 (default command)
   snap: review and accept Nullean.Snapshots snapshots. Without a command, walks through the pending snapshots one by one.

Options for this default:
  --root <string>  The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

Global options:
  -h, --help  Show help.
  --version   Show version.

Namespaces:
  http     Run .http files and compare their responses with the verified
           snapshots.
  journey  Run browser journeys and compare their transcripts with the verified
           snapshots.

Commands:
  accept   Accept received snapshots: write them as verified and delete the
           received files. An inline snapshot is written into the string literal
           of its test instead, which edits the test's .cs file.
  diff     Show how a received snapshot differs from its verified file.
  orphans  List verified snapshots the latest test run did not use. Exits 1 when
           there are any.
  reject   Reject received snapshots: delete the received files and keep the
           verified ones.
  review   Review pending snapshots one by one: see each diff, then accept,
           reject or skip it.
  status   List pending snapshots. Exits 1 when there are any.

result.stdout:
Usage: snap accept [<keys...>] [options]

   Accept received snapshots: write them as verified and delete the received files. An inline snapshot is written into the string literal of its test instead, which edits the test's .cs file.

Arguments:
  [<keys...>]  [variadic] Keys from 'snap status', unique suffixes of them, or globs.

Global options:
  -h, --help       Show help.

Options:
  --all            Accept every pending snapshot.
  --root <string>  The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

result.stdout:
Usage: snap orphans [options]

   List verified snapshots the latest test run did not use. Exits 1 when there are any.

Global options:
  -h, --help       Show help.

Options:
  --json           Print a JSON array of {project, verified} instead.
  --delete         Delete them. Run the whole test suite first: a filtered run skips snapshots.
  --root <string>  The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]
